title: Seven Years off the Form
subtitle: 年龄与时代 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 年龄与时代（人与自我·年龄与时代）
meta: 主题语境：年龄与时代（人与自我·年龄与时代）　|　核心词汇：age　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 age 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather was asked his ① age by a man with a form and said sixty-one, which was seven years out, and he never corrected it and the form went in. He had left school ② at the age of nine and said an age is only a number somebody else needs, and I have never been able to argue with that.

The ③ age of the machines he worked on ended in 1963, and he said the word age is what people use for a thing that has finished. He was seventy by then, and he said ④ old age is the only age that surprises you, and that every other age you see coming from a long way off; age, he said, is the one thing you gain and lose at once.

They had ⑤ known each other for ages, by which my grandmother meant since 1924, and she said the phrase was the only honest one in the language. He ⑥ came of age in 1911, in a year nobody now remembers, and he said coming of age is the only birthday that is not about you; the age, she said, is not the years but the knowing.

The ⑦ age he lived in, which the books call the age of steam, he called the age of the seven o'clock bell. There was ⑧ a whole age in that room, he said, meaning the forty-one years and one bench, and he said it had taken ages and had gone in an afternoon.

The  age I think about is the seven years he took off the form, which he never explained and which nobody in the family has ever mentioned. An  age, he told me in 1978, is the only thing a man can be wrong about and still be right, because the number is his and the years are not, and every age is a kind of debt.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 老年；晚年（old age）
D. n. 很久；很长时间（常用复数 ages）
E. 固定搭配：at the age of ... 在……岁时
F. 固定搭配：the age of ... ……的时代
G. 固定搭配：for ages 很久；好长时间
H. 固定搭配：come of age 成年；达到法定年龄

items.q: asked his age by a man with a form
The age of the machines he worked on
old age is the only age that surprises
There was a whole age in that room

answers.why: age 意为“年龄”，1957 年有人拿着表格问祖父的年龄，他说六十一，其实差了七年。
at the age of ... 意为“在……岁时”，他九岁就离开了学校。
the age of ... 意为“……的时代”，他修理的那些机器的时代在 1963 年结束了。
old age 意为“老年、晚年”，他说老年是唯一让你吃惊的年纪。
for ages 意为“很久”，祖母说的“认识很久”，其实是从 1924 年算起。
come of age 意为“成年”，他 1911 年成年，那是如今没人记得的一年。
age 意为“时代”，书上称他生活的时代为蒸汽时代，他自己叫它七点钟铃的时代。
ages 意为“很久、很长时间”，他说那间屋子里装着整整一个时代——四十一年和一条长凳，也说他耗了很久，而它一个下午就走了。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年有人拿着表格问祖父的年龄，他说六十一，其实差了七年。（age）
他九岁就离开了学校，他说年龄只是别人需要的一个数字。（at the age of）
他修理的那些机器的时代在 1963 年结束了。（the age of）
他说老年是唯一让你吃惊的年纪，别的年纪老远就能看见。（old age）
他们认识很久了——祖母的意思是自 1924 年起。（for ages）
他 1911 年成年，那是如今没人记得的一年。（come of age）
answers: In 1957 my grandfather was asked his age by a man with a form and said sixty-one, which was seven years out.
He left school at the age of nine and said an age is only a number somebody else needs.
The age of the machines he worked on ended in 1963.
He said old age is the only age that surprises you, and every other age you see coming.
They had known each other for ages, by which my grandmother meant since 1924.
He came of age in 1911, in a year nobody now remembers.
